scope: Structural certification of the EVIDENCE foundations: the H0 entity model, append-only entity store and ENT issuer (ADR-0114 WP-E1), and the H1 event model, append-only event store, separate confirmation records, EVR issuer and seeded event-class vocabulary (ADR-0115 WP-E2), and the H2 historical ledger, protected holdouts, pre-registered protocols and purpose-declared access log (ADR-0116 WP-E3), and the H4 evidence model, append-only evidence store, EVD and RUL issuers, provenance-checked joins, decomposable aggregates and structural relationship records (ADR-0119 WP-E4), and the H5 interpretation rule registry, its hash-pinned fail-closed snapshot and the governed RUL authoring process (ADR-0120 WP-E5; ADR-0121), and the provenance graph recorded at evidence-creation time (ADR-0122 WP-E6).

reference.structure: the model contracts of ADR-0114 s3, ADR-0115 s5, ADR-0116 s5, ADR-0119 s5, ADR-0120 s6 and ADR-0122 s6, exercised on synthetic records

explicit_non_claims: structural certification only: this is not astrological-calculation certification
declares no production analytical input, and is served by no API
makes no analytical claim: nothing here scores, weights, fits or computes confidence
every record used is synthetic; no real personal data is certified or permitted
the event-class seed is certified equal to the registry, not the registry's classes correct; the registry stays DRAFT and its origin column is carried, not ratified
admissibility as validation input is a gate on system hypotheses and rejections only; H2 and H4 may add requirements
SUPPORT_PATHS_V1 gates H and I still certify the H0 foundations; this artifact does not retire them

the ledger's purpose check and leakage check cover reads through the ledger only: EventStore, EntityStore, the ledger's own database connection and direct SQLite access read protected events without a purpose and without a log entry, and no such read can be detected here
the store draws the holdout seed and forbids refreezing any frozen event, but cannot stop a caller recording near-duplicate events to build a new eligible set
no TEST record, performance measurement or validation-run result is certified: they need H5 and rule application
rule-version references are synthetic structural references: not proof of registration or validation in a future real-rule registry, and they authorize no interpretation

every rule the pinned snapshot publishes is a synthetic fixture rule: no real rule is transcribed, sourced or attributed, and the registry's certification claims are all not_assessed. The publication mechanism for genuine rules is exercised only on test snapshots with a test source (ADR-0130)
a genuine rule, once published, is never projected into evidence; the explanation boundary renders only trusted data and contains no LLM client, so no generated text is evaluated here
no rule condition is evaluated against a chart and no rule is applied; that belongs to INTERPRETATION
RUL issuance is append-only against the base commit in CI; the gate cannot see allocations made in an unreviewed fork that was never merged
no rule is applied and no chart is interpreted: evidence items are synthetic records exercising the model
confidence components and historical performance are carried as supplied or absent, never computed; measured reliability, cross-method and timing convergence are absent
relationships are classified only from each item's own recorded inputs, derivation links and completeness statements; no convergence count or bound is computed, and CORRELATED is never assigned
the store cannot verify that a producer's completeness statements are true; it only refuses to call a pair INDEPENDENT without them
the provenance graph is recorded, not computed over: no path, independent count, cut, score, weight or ratio is computed, and relationship classification does not read it
the graph records only what each item and the store's records state; it cannot show that a producer's recorded inputs are all it consumed, and records incompleteness where the producer states it
no CORRELATED_WITH edge is recorded: correlation is measured, and nothing in EVIDENCE measures
a persisted graph read refuses rows the items' stored records do not account for; it cannot detect a forged evidence record whose own graph rows were forged to agree with it

a rule version recorded under another snapshot is read as history, because no earlier snapshot is archived to check it against: a forged row claiming another snapshot, with matching forged graph rows, is not detected
a persisted relationship is checked against what the recorded items support; it shows agreement with the recorded structure, and does not show that two items are independent in fact
the graph's node and edge kinds adopt the recording schema of docs/EVIDENCE_INDEPENDENCE_DESIGN.md s3 only (ADR-0122 D1); that document stays PROPOSED in every other respect

trust_records.residual_limitation: coordinated edits to every repository-held trust record cannot be cryptographically prevented by an in-repository trust anchor; only upstream provenance would anchor this, and it is out of M1 scope

justified_exceptions: Frozen holdout declarations and oracle imports are permitted only outside engine/; all scanned sources remain subject to suspicious-identifier detection.
